policy_nonstationarity_assessment.evidence: The historical targets span five sequential policy updates, with nonzero Macro and Micro KL. Macro KL is small (about 8.4e-6 to 4.9e-5); Micro KL ranges about 5.7e-4 to 4.0e-3. No per-episode policy snapshot was stored with each replay batch, so the target contribution from policy drift cannot be isolated quantitatively.
policy_nonstationarity_assessment.interpretation: Stale-policy target drift can contribute, but it is not sufficient to explain the observed transfer failure: poor unseen EV and high same-action target conflict persist when all five targets are generated under one frozen policy.
